observations: Photo 0 shows a front-load LG washing machine with a visible LG logo.
On the control panel/door area it reads: “DirectDrive 7kg” (clearly visible).
There is visible rust/staining around the lower front panel area.
No photo shows the model number plate, power-on status, or the drum/door seal condition in detail.

claims.claim: LG DirectDrive 7kg washing machine for sale.
claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows “LG” and “DirectDrive 7kg” on the machine.
No photo metadata or location proof is provided.

risks.risk: Capacity mismatch: seller says 8kg but photo shows 7kg; this affects value.
risks.proof: Ask for a clear photo of the rating/model plate (usually behind the door frame or on the side/back) showing the exact kg capacity.
risks.if_unproven: Price as the photo-indicated 7kg (worst case vs seller’s 8kg claim).

risks.risk: Rust/staining on the lower front panel may indicate corrosion or water ingress affecting longevity.
risks.proof: Ask for a close-up photo of the rust area plus a photo of the bottom/underbody (if accessible) and the door seal/gasket.
risks.if_unproven: Price as used with cosmetic/possible moisture damage (worst case).

risks.risk: Working condition is unknown (no power-on/test cycle shown).
risks.proof: Ask for a short video of the machine running a full wash cycle (or at least spin) with water filling and draining.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not proven working (worst case).

risks.risk: Model number/inverter/direct drive variant not fully verifiable from the single photo; could affect parts availability/value.
risks.proof: Ask for a photo of the full model/serial label (rating plate) and the back panel label.
risks.if_unproven: Price at the lower end for LG used washing machines in this market.

proof_requests: Clear photo of the rating/model plate showing exact capacity (kg), model number, and serial.
Close-up photos of the rust/staining area and the door gasket/seal.
Short video of a wash + spin cycle (showing it fills, agitates/drums, drains, and spins).
Photo of the back panel (power/inlet/drain connections) to check for leaks or damage.
response.reason: The photo clearly identifies an LG DirectDrive 7kg unit, contradicting the seller’s “8kg” claim. With only one photo and no proof of working condition, it should be priced at the worst case for used/unknown-working condition and possible corrosion.
